title: Hearty German Stew
description: A traditional German stew made with tender beef, root vegetables, and a rich broth. This hearty dish is perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef on all sides, then remove it from the pot.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is softened.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, red wine, tomato paste, thyme, salt, and pepper to the pot.
Return the beef to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Braise the stew for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
